desc.zh: 用阶乘分块、从零计数和可逆账本直接定位第 k 个排列。
desc.en: Locate permutation k with factorial blocks, zero-based ranks and a reversible ledger.

concepts.name: factorial blocks
concepts.description: Equal contiguous blocks for each next digit.

concepts.name: zero-based rank
concepts.description: Choose an unused digit by quotient and retain the remainder.
